rationale: The standard requires six separable acts: developing group norms, discussing texts, sharing individual writing, listening to others' writing, offering feedback, and responding to feedback. The resource partially meets the norm-development clause: students discuss how to show respect during the Role-Play protocol ("'How will you show respect during our Role-Play protocol?' (I will listen to my partner and not make fun of him or her.)") and reflect on what respect looked and sounded like, but the norm itself is teacher-introduced rather than student-developed. The discuss-texts clause is met: students discuss Summer Sun Risin' by answering text-based questions (e.g., "'What is Pa doing?' (opening the barn door a little bit)"). With two clauses at least partially met and four not met, the alignment is partial.
